summary: Iter 40 - Validated new cash-report features: online_belum_cair totals in /api/reports/cash and new /api/reports/cash/daily endpoint; verified Laba Rugi UI kas-belum-cair amber box + Rincian Arus Kas Harian table with PDF/Excel exports.
critical_code_review_comments: cash_events() uses re.escape(period or '') with a $regex on created_at; works, but a plain string prefix match (e.g. {'$gte': period, '$lt': next}) would be more index-friendly if the collection grows large.
report_cash_daily does not expose saldo_awal_kas (always starts cumulative at 0 for the period), matching the UI note - OK, but worth documenting.
Pending online sales are excluded from kas_saat_ini (good) and surfaced separately as online_belum_cair - matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Test period 2097-03: inserted 2 Selesai + 2 pending ecommerce_sales, 1 transaction, 1 disbursed loan, 1 expense, 1 purchase - all tagged test_mark and cleaned up in fixture teardown. No persistent seed left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/reports/cash (with online_belum_cair fields) and /api/reports/cash/daily behave per spec. Daily rows sum equals /api/reports/cash totals for same period, and last saldo_berjalan == kas_saat_ini. Pending ecommerce (Diproses/Dikirim) correctly excluded from omzet/kas. Laba Rugi page renders data-testids kas-belum-cair, kas-belum-cair-amount, kas-belum-cair-count, cash-daily-card, cash-daily-table, cash-daily-row-{date}, cash-daily-total, cash-daily-export-pdf, cash-daily-export-excel.
